slides.texte_overlay:
habits that will make you
unreasonably confident

the calm disagreement

once a week, disagree out loud with something you don't believe, calmly and kindly. people respect a clear opinion far more than a polite yes they can tell you didn't mean.

what did you mean

when a comment stings, ask "what did you mean by that?" in a calm voice. most little digs fall apart the moment you ask someone to say them a second time.

the first sentence on paper

before any hard conversation, write the one sentence you need to say on paper. walking in with a clear first line makes everything after it so much easier.

psychology minutes

give 5 minutes a day to one idea from psychology: why we people please, how habits form, what makes arguments go wrong. understanding people makes them much less scary.

give 5 minutes a day to one idea from psychology: why we people please, how habits form. a micro-learning app like the Sophia app makes it easy, and people become much less scary.

no over explaining

when you say no this week, give one reason or none at all, never five. over explaining sounds like asking for permission, and you don't need anyone's permission.
